units: <cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 2:2">Meg. II, 2</cite> <he>ומִתְנַמְנֵם</he> or (he read the Book of Esther) while he was half asleep.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:8">Pes. X, 8</cite> <he>נִתְנַמְנְמוּ</he> if they napped (at the table), opp. <he>נרדמו</he>.
Ib. 120ᵇ; Meg. 18ᵇ היכי דמי נתנמנם what condition is meant by nithnamnem?, v. נים.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 1:7">Yoma I, 7</cite> <he>בקש להִתְנַמְנֵם</he> if he showed a disposition to fall asleep; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:11">Koh. R. to V, 11</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>נתנ׳ עבדא ודמך ליה</he> the slave was overcome with drowsiness and fell asleep.
